aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer; no staging criteria are given in the abstract.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: However, 25(OH) levels were slightly positively associated with advanced cancer.
study_design: Prospective nested case-control study within the Japan Public Health Center-based Prospective Study.
reason: New prostate cancers were identified prospectively during follow-up. The abstract analyzes total incident prostate cancer and also reports an association with advanced cancer, but it does not provide the advanced-case count or advanced-specific effect and confidence interval.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: We did not observe statistically significant association between 25(OH)D level and total prostate cancer (multivariate OR=1.13 (95%CI=0.66-1.94, P<sub>trend</sub>=0.94) for the highest versus lowest tertile) However, 25(OH) levels were slightly positively associated with advanced cancer.
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported OR of 1.13 is explicitly for total prostate cancer, not advanced cancer.

additional_estimates.comparison: Plasma 25-hydroxy vitamin D levels; advanced-cancer contrast not reported in the abstract.
additional_estimates.effect_excerpt: However, 25(OH) levels were slightly positively associated with advanced cancer.
additional_estimates.endpoint_definition: Advanced prostate cancer; staging criteria were not reported in the abstract.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
